earnings.title: The Cincinnati Insurance Company n The Cincinnati Indemnity Company
highlights: Third-quarter 2026 net income of $459 million, or $2.96 per share, compared with $1.122 billion, or $7.11 per share, in the third quarter of 2025, after recognizing a less than $1 million third-quarter 2026 after-tax increase in the fair value of equity securities still held.
Third-quarter 2026 non-GAAP operating income* of $443 million, or $2.86 per share, compared with $449 million, or $2.85 per share, in the third quarter of last year.

items.heading: Loss reserves, our largest liability, are based on estimates and could be inadequate to cover actual losses.
We could experience an unusually high level of losses due to natural or man-made catastrophe, terrorism or epidemic events or risk concentrations.
Climate change may adversely impact our results of operations and/or our financial position.
Our ability to properly underwrite and price risks and increased competition could adversely affect our results.
Our ability to obtain or collect on our reinsurance protection could affect our business, financial condition, results of operations or cash flows.
Our credit ratings or financial strength ratings of our insurance subsidiaries could be downgraded.
